scripts.db:up: docker start novus-pg 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name novus-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=novus -e POSTGRES_USER=novus -e POSTGRES_DB=novus -p 5433:5432 postgres:16
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @novus/contracts build && pnpm --filter @novus/control-plane build && pnpm --filter @novus/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @novus/contracts test && pnpm --filter @novus/control-plane test && pnpm --filter @novus/desktop test
